covered_report_window: After the U.S. market close on Monday, October 12, 2026 through before the U.S. market open on Tuesday, October 13, 2026. No qualified Monday after-close names were found; all nine qualified companies report Tuesday before the open.
market_context_summary: U.S. stocks were mixed near records during a thin Columbus Day session while the cash Treasury market was closed. Energy led as oil traded near $94, technology lagged, and Wednesday CPI was the next major macro catalyst; the immediate earnings window was dominated by banks and healthcare.
